verdict.rationale: Public status lookup is a fair question for a state tax and filing agency, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two probes, which recorded Akamai 403 denials at www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt and at webapp.ftb.ca.gov. Neither says anything about a public page for checking the status of a filing, application, or case, so there is no evidence the capability exists.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
